description: Signal Pulse scans a business by name and website and reports whether AI assistants can find, describe, and recommend it accurately. It returns a Signal Strength rating (Strong, Weak, Low, or No Signal), a 0-100 score, a schema markup scan, and a per-platform summary of AI mentions. Built by Signal & Structure AI, an independent AI-discoverability consultancy, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI. Free, one check per email, full report emailed to the requester.
